name: ClipPath
description: A widget that clips its child using a custom path. Useful for creating complex shapes, custom designs, or animations.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget to display inside the custom path.

properties.name: clipper
properties.description: A custom clipper that defines the clipping path.

properties.name: clipBehavior
properties.description: How to clip the content if it overflows the custom path.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.
